doubts.claim_under_doubt: Agents pill reachable only via the Info sidebar (phone Info tab, collapsed desktop sidebar, design gate).
doubts.disproof_attempt: Agents pill reachable only via the Info sidebar (phone Info tab, collapsed desktop sidebar, design gate).
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Accepted in writing: the product owner asked to REMOVE the old chat placement and put the pill in the Environment card. Design gate: MissionInfoSidebar is its own always-mounted panel, independent of the feed (rebutted). Phone: pill is on the Info tab (V9 e2e updated). A collapsed desktop sidebar hides it; chat subrunner cards still open the window. Disclosed to the owner.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Files & Terminal controller has no chat cards: no event-driven rescan, window lacks report/hand-back text.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Files & Terminal controller has no chat cards: no event-driven rescan, window lacks report/hand-back text.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Accepted and disclosed as a known limitation: count refreshes when the tab becomes visible, on window open, focus and task-state change; the F&T window shows prompt/answer/transcript but not the chat-card report/hand-back extras. Hidden-tab window is closed (fixed).
Each controller has its own open state; the F&T window closes when the tab hides; V10 e2e opens and closes the window in both tabs sequentially.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: New default widths do not reach users with stored widths.
doubts.disproof_attempt: New default widths do not reach users with stored widths.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Fixed for the common case: a stored Mission sidebar width equal to the old default 320 (persisted by any segment change) is treated as unset (useMissionSidebar.test.ts). Deliberately dragged widths are kept; parity is guaranteed for default widths only. Disclosed.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Gutter count in the percentage maths.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Gutter count in the percentage maths.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Rebutted: PaneSplitter is hidden only in compact/maximized (which the maths already excludes); collapsed or tablet states keep both 16px handles in the layout. Real-browser bounding-box parity verified at 1440px.
Rebutted: tokens are in :root (weather-deck.css line 55 block); computed 13px asserted in V5/V10 e2e; warn pill about 5.5:1 on the light card, seen in screenshots.
Complemented by computed-style assertions in V10 e2e (font size, shadow, opaque background, bounding boxes).
